findings.description: The separator condition is inverted, changing the help output for options with secondary spellings.
findings.rationale: For a boolean option declared as `--foo/--no-foo`, `any_prefix_is_slash` is false, so the new code displays `--foo; --no-foo` instead of the previous `--foo / --no-foo`. Slash-prefixed option pairs likewise receive `/` instead of `;`, making the separator ambiguous with the option prefixes.
